## Problem

What's the gap or pain point? What can't you do today, or what's awkward?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. If it maps to an existing MASTERPLAN.md section, note
which one.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Scope check

- [ ] I checked `STATUS.md` / `masterplan-completion-audit.md` and this isn't already
      implemented or explicitly pending
- [ ] This doesn't require a new architectural decision that should go through
      `MASTERPLAN.md` first (if it does, please open a discussion instead)

## Additional context

Mockups, references, or related issues.
